causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The unplanned outage of Delta Electricity's Wallerawang unit eight at 3.33 pm led to a significant change in dispatch in order to manage network constraints in the vicinity.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: Following the loss of Wallerawang unit eight, the system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S violated from 3.40 pm to 4 pm inclusive.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The violation of this constraint led to flows into New South Wales across all interconnectors (QNI, Terranora and Vic-NSW) exceeding their import limits for the same period.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 3.35 pm Delta Electricity rebid the ramp down rate of Mount Piper units one and two... Due to Mount Piper's ramp down rate being reduced, other generators were 'constrained-off' and flows across the interconnectors were reduced to prevent the constraint from being breached.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 3.34 pm Delta Electricity (in response to the unit trip ) reduced available capacity at Wallerawang unit eight by around 500 MW... The constraint violated from 3.40 pm to 4 pm, inclusive.

constraints_named.quote: the system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S violated from 3.40 pm to 4 pm inclusive
